name: copilot_reviewer
description: Call GPT-4.1 (default) or o4-mini (security) via GitHub Models for independent review. Use alongside gemini_advisor for multi-model gates. review_type='strategy' uses gpt-4.1 for business analysis. review_type='security_review' auto-selects o4-mini (reasoning model). Use for: (1) Phase 1.5 business/security advisory, (2) Phase 2 design feasibility, (3) Phase 4 code quality, (4) Phase 5 UAT compliance.

problem.description: What to review — e.g. 'Phase 1.5 business strategy for P2026-003', 'Phase 4 code quality for P2026-002'

context.description: Code snippets, specs, documents, or file contents to review

focus.description: Specific areas to focus on, e.g. ['anti-patterns', 'test coverage', 'TypeScript safety']

model.description: Override model: 'gpt-4.1' (default, best general), 'o4-mini' (reasoning, best for security/logic). Auto-selected if not specified.
